objective: Implement the reviewed v0.1 append-only daily-source repair path: one shared active-source resolver, class-wide discovery across every registered daily must-publish source and historical date, hash-frozen planning, and an atomic approval-bound apply operation that preserves every original batch.
non_goals: Do not read or modify the production ~/ar-live runtime while implementing or testing this task.
Do not fetch replacement market data in the implementation PR.
Do not repair any production SQLite batch before a reviewed implementation is merged and Junyan approves the exact scan_hash and plan_hash.
Do not rewrite historical packets, U4 decisions, paper registrations, or model claims.
Do not grant selection, paper, trade, portfolio, or formal blocking authority.
Do not implement FF-2 through FF-5 in this PR.
dependencies: PR #311 Semiconductor Daily Source Repair Plan V0.1
input_contracts: ar.semiconductor_positive_inputs.v1 immutable source batches and rows
Junyan literal approval bound to one exact scan_hash and plan_hash
output_artifacts: Deterministic class-wide read-only scan and scan_hash
Explicit hash-frozen repair plan and plan_hash
Append-only atomic repair storage and verification CLI
Behavior-level negative regressions and mutation-gate coverage
acceptance_tests: Prove original batches and original rows remain byte-for-byte unchanged after a repair.
Prove snapshot construction consumes the unique verified active repair rather than the superseded source body.
Prove forks, cycles, orphan predecessors, duplicate active heads, and hash drift fail closed.
Prove the scanner derives every source from DAILY_MUST_PUBLISH_SOURCES and every historical date rather than a hardcoded source/date list.
Prove the scan emits the complete registered-source by historical-date Cartesian set, including explicit SOURCE_PUBLICATION_PENDING rows for missing pairs.
Prove zero and under-covered replacements are rejected under the same 95 percent policy as forward ingestion.
Prove every repair carries a rehashed raw provider-capture receipt and complete internally consistent normalized evidence.
Prove V0.1 never promotes self-reported publication time to PIT_VERIFIED and keeps repaired same-day research evidence DATA_BLOCKED.
Prove a changed scan or plan between review and apply is rejected before any write.
Prove exact retries are idempotent, concurrent apply is atomic, and injected failures roll back completely.
Prove INSERT OR REPLACE cannot mutate either append-only repair table and every committed run binds the complete repair catalog.
Prove the production feature-store path and nightly lock derive from one explicit runtime root with no independent CLI override.
Prove repaired replay preserves the E1 veto and cannot create a positive same-day trigger from late evidence.
Prove no repair artifact can carry selection, paper, trade, portfolio, claim, or formal blocking authority.
Prove weakening the resolver call, class-wide scan, old-artifact binding, or no-zero rule makes a dedicated mutation case fail.
Run the repair suite, semiconductor input suite, no-network guard, mutation gate, and exact-head CI before merge.
approval_gates: Independent adversarial review is required before merge.
Implementation merge does not authorize a production write.
Production apply requires a fresh read-only class scan, a frozen explicit plan, and Junyan's literal approval naming the exact scan_hash and plan_hash.
Any scope, source, date, predecessor, replacement, or hash drift stops the apply for renewed approval.
